title: OpenBao PKI
description: OpenBao PKI. Native SPL operator-question bindings. Read panel descriptions for windows, missing data, and required external sources. Native alert parity is not mapped. See the profile validation record for tested environments.

options.query:
`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(roles|issue|issuer|issuers|root|cert|certs|tidy|revoke|crl|config|intermediate|sign|sign-verbatim)(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(roles|issue|issuer|issuers|root|cert|certs|tidy|revoke|crl|config|intermediate|sign|sign-verbatim)(/|$)")
| timechart span=5m count BY host limit=10 useother=t

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(issue|sign|sign-verbatim|cert|certs|revoke)(/|$)")
| timechart span=5m count BY host limit=10 useother=t

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(issue|sign|sign-verbatim|cert|certs|revoke|tidy|crl)(/|$)")
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip audit_error

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where match(mvjoin(audit_error," "),"(?is)(permission denied|forbidden)") AND (audit_type="response" OR (audit_type="request" AND match(mvjoin(audit_error," "),"(?i)^forbidden$"))) AND match(request_path,"^.+/(roles|issue|issuer|issuers|root|cert|certs|tidy|revoke|crl|config|intermediate|sign|sign-verbatim)(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_pki_issue_failure")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_pki_issue_failure"
| eval series=case(metric_name="vault_pki_issue_failure","pki_issue_failure") ." | ".coalesce(openbao_namespace,"(missing)") ." | ".cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| `openbao_metric_rate15m`
| eval value=value*900
| stats sum(value) AS value BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile series
| eval _time=bucket_time
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile series
| stats sum(value) AS value count AS contributing_series
| where contributing_series>0
| fields - contributing_series

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_pki_issue_count")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_pki_issue_count"
| eval series=case(metric_name="vault_pki_issue_count","pki_issue") ." | ".coalesce(openbao_namespace,"(missing)") ." | ".cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| `openbao_metric_rate5m`
| stats sum(value) AS value BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile series
| eval _time=bucket_time
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile series
| stats sum(value) AS value count AS contributing_series
| where contributing_series>0
| fields - contributing_series

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_pki_*")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_pki_issue_failure" OR metric_name="vault_pki_revoke_failure"
| eval series=case(metric_name="vault_pki_issue_failure","issue",metric_name="vault_pki_revoke_failure","revoke") ." | ".coalesce(openbao_namespace,"(missing)") ." | ".cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| `openbao_metric_rate15m`
| eval value=value*900
| stats sum(value) AS value BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile series
| eval _time=bucket_time
| timechart span=15s max(value) BY series limit=20 useother=f cont=f

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_pki_*")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_pki_issue_sum" OR metric_name="vault_pki_issue_count" OR metric_name="vault_pki_revoke_sum" OR metric_name="vault_pki_revoke_count"
| eval series=case(metric_name="vault_pki_issue_sum","issue",metric_name="vault_pki_issue_count","issue",metric_name="vault_pki_revoke_sum","revoke",metric_name="vault_pki_revoke_count","revoke") ." | ".coalesce(openbao_namespace,"(missing)") ." | ".cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| `openbao_metric_rate5m`
| stats sum(eval(if(match(metric_name,"_sum$"),value,null()))) AS total sum(eval(if(match(metric_name,"_count$"),value,null()))) AS observations BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile series
| where observations>0
| eval value=total/observations
| eval _time=bucket_time
| timechart span=15s max(value) BY series limit=20 useother=f cont=f
